LESSON: READING 7.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: VISUALS

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals, part of Strand 7 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What information do we obtain from visuals? 2. How can one interpret a visual correctly?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. make a connection between visuals and the written text,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. interpret visuals correctly for meaning,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

C. interpret visuals correctly for meaning,

   Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

D. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation.

   Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals helps learners achieve this outcome through discussion, practice, and activities at school. Think about how this applies in daily life in Kenya — at home, on the farm, in town, or at school.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 7.2.1 Intensive Reading: Visuals together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: It is fostered as the learner interacts with information from various visual materials on human wildlife conflict.

• Learning to learn: It is enhanced as the learner works independently to make visuals in line with the theme of wildlife.

Values:
Patriotism: It is promoted as the learner acquires knowledge on his or her environment while reading about the importance of

wildlife.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental and social issues: These are promoted as the learner learns the importance of co-existing with wildlife.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate visuals as an aspect of learning in Pre- technical Studies

Main points to remember:

1. identify different visuals in given contexts correctly,
2. make a connection between visuals and the written text,
3. interpret visuals correctly for meaning,
4. appreciate the role of visuals in simplifying representation.
